description: Bars with a rounded end, which Vega-Lite draws by wrapping each stack in a group positioned by `y`/`y2` and marked `clip: true` — so the radius rounds the stack rather than every segment in it. That wrapper is why this fixture exists: a group is rect-like and takes its extent from `y2` as readily as from `height`, and reading only `height` made the group zero-high. Because it clips, it clipped away the very bars it was there to round: the chart drew its axes, its gridlines and its labels, and no data, with no diagnostic. A colour ramp is on it too, so the bars are distinguishable from one another and from the background in whatever draws them.
